title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum: The Most Profitable Stretch of Road
summary: Each town reports its best one-way road down, drops losing branches, and checks the best route that bends through it.

analogy.scenario: Towns are linked by roads with no loops. Stopping in a town earns or costs money, and a delivery van wants the most profitable stretch of road, which can start and end at any towns.

mapping.real: A town and what a stop there earns
The best one-way road down from a town
Skipping a branch that loses money
The best stretch found so far
Towns waiting for their branches' reports

takeaway.pattern: Depth-first search (post-order, with a global best)
takeaway.summary: gain(node) = node + the better of its children's gains, ignoring negative ones. At each node, left + node + right is a candidate for the best path; only one side can be handed up.
whenToUse: Best path anywhere in a tree, not just from the root
A node must combine both subtrees but can pass only one up

scenes.narration: Towns are linked by roads with no loops, and a stop earns or costs money. A van can drive any stretch, starting and ending anywhere. What's the most it can earn?
scenes.caption: Some towns earn money, some cost it: find the best stretch

scenes.narration: You could try every pair of towns and add up the road between them, but that's a quadratic number of stretches, each walked again.
scenes.caption: Trying every pair of towns means O(n²) stretches

scenes.narration: Instead, each town asks its two branches for their best one-way road down, then decides. Town 2 starts.
scenes.caption: Each town asks: what's the best road going down from you?

scenes.narration: Town minus 6 has no branches, so its best stretch is just minus 6, the best so far. It reports minus 6, and any town above will skip that branch.
scenes.caption: Town -6 only loses money: its branch counts as 0

scenes.narration: Towns 3 and 4 report 3 and 4. A stretch can bend at town 5 and use both: 12, the new best. But only one side can continue upward, so town 5 reports 5 plus 4, which is 9.
scenes.caption: At town 5: 3 + 5 + 4 = 12, a new best

scenes.narration: Town 2 skips the losing branch and bends through itself: 0 plus 2 plus 9 is 11, not better than 12. The best stretch is 3, 5, 4, earning 12.
scenes.caption: Town 2 skips the -6 branch: 0 + 2 + 9 = 11 < 12

scenes.narration: Towns are nodes, the report is gain, and skipping a loss is max with 0. Each node checks left plus itself plus right against the best. One visit each: O(n) time, O(h) space.
scenes.caption: Towns are nodes; the report up is the gain
